exposure: Infants of mothers with TSH levels above two different cutoffs
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
Offspring development (Bayley-III test) at 6 and 15 months
cohort: 77 singleton-pregnant women undergoing planned cesarean section
finding: While no differences in birth outcomes or anthropometrics were observed, offspring of mothers with SCH, particularly males and those with lower TSH cutoffs, showed decreased cognitive and motor scores at 6 and 15 months.
